commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Deathtouch
The first instant or sorcery spell you cast each turn has casualty 2. (As you cast that spell, you may sacrifice a creature with power 2 or greater. When you do, copy the spell and you may choose new targets for the copy.)

source_basis.known_approval_project_exceptions: Explicit user approval after full 99-slot audit, rules/combo verification, candidate exhaustion, red-team review, and zero-new-material-improvement closure.

strategy.primary: Spell-copy spellslinger: keep cheap power-2+ bodies around to pay casualty 2 on the first instant or sorcery each turn (on every player's turn), copying tutors, removal, extra turns and finishers.
strategy.secondary: Commander-independent spell-copy infinites (Twinning Staff or Reiterate + Narset's Reversal, Dualcaster Mage + Twinflame, Reiterate + Mana Geyser/Jeska's Will, Primal Wellspring + Frantic Search).

role.advances_plan: Anhelo turns one spell per turn into two and makes token makers double as copy fuel; his deathtouch body also blocks.
role.honest_note: The deck's kills are mostly two-card spell-copy infinites that do not need Anhelo; he is a value engine (one casualty per turn), not the win condition. Calling him 'central' would overstate it.

identity_core.why: Grants casualty 2 every turn: the one effect no other card in the deck provides.
Adds a copy to every casualty copy and loops Narset's Reversal.
Steady supply of sacrificial bodies that turns the casualty cost into value.
Cheap interaction that is also the core copy-loop piece.
Magecraft draws on copies, so every casualty copy cantrips.
